## Foco

- Ingeniería inversa y análisis de malware (PE/ELF, Ghidra, x64dbg, Radare2/rizin).
- Investigación de vulnerabilidades: memory safety, auth/integrity bypass, SSRF, injection, traversal, deserialization.
- Seguridad OT/ICS: Siemens S5/S7, bytecode MC7, protocolos industriales y firmware.
- Threat intelligence y OSINT: infraestructura criminal, fraude financiero transfronterizo, wallets y TTPs.
- Infraestructura reproducible para investigación (Proxmox, QEMU/KVM, Docker/Podman, Ansible, Terraform).

## Trabajo seleccionado

- analystty — tooling de triage de binarios PE.
- SAINT GRAIL — taxonomía de evidencia y threat hunting.
- Threat Hunter Recollection — threat intelligence y OSINT.
- MC7/S7 — reversing de bytecode y PLC Siemens.
- infra-soc — laboratorio SOC / honeypot reproducible.

## English summary

Christian Márquez (tty503) is a self-taught security researcher based in Venezuela. His work focuses on reverse engineering, malware analysis, vulnerability research, OT/ICS security, threat intelligence and OSINT. The site is available in Spanish, English, Chinese, Russian, Hebrew and Arabic. PGP fingerprint: DE68 AA7C F75E D73B 35A5 92DA B237 FD25 B8E3 D2A7.
